item.title: Iran's army helicopter crashes in Dorcheh, killing at least 2
item.description: ALBAWABA - At least two people were killed in a military helicopter crash in Iran, local media reported on Tuesday.Mehr news agency said that a helicopter crashed in the Dorcheh area of Khomeini Shahr in Isfahan Province, killing the pilot and the co-pilot.According to Mehr, the helicopter was conducting a training at the time of the incident.The plane crash occurred inside the compound of the local wholesale fruit and vegetable market in Dorcheh.
